text:
maria (customer): Hey @support — we're seeing credits not change for some of our API calls. Two requests in a row returned 200, but our dashboard shows 0 token use and our app didn't consume any quota. Can you check?

ben (support): Sorry about that, can you paste one curl from the failing request and the response body? Also need your account id and the request timestamps.

maria (customer): curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-small-1","prompt":"hello","max_tokens":16}'
Response: 200 OK, body: {"id":"resp_abc123","object":"generation","choices":[{"text":"hi"}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":3,"completion_tokens":0,"total_tokens":3}}
Dashboard still shows no deduction. account_id: acct_999, ts: 2025-11-03T14:22:34Z

ben (support): Got it. Quick check: did the client close the connection early or cancel streaming? If the TCP connection was cut the billing flow can be inconsistent — but that shouldn't show 0 total_tokens in the API response.

maria (customer): Not on purpose. We're using the official SDK which calls the REST endpoint and waits; no streaming. We also retried once with idempotency key set and then saw the same 200 and same usage block.

ben (support): Thanks — I'm going to escalate to billing and infra to pull logs and ledger entries. Can you also confirm the SDK version? There was a patch for token accounting in 0.9.2.

maria (customer): SDK v0.9.1. We can try upgrading but need to know whether to expect credits restored.

infra-bot: New internal ticket created: REDW-4829 — investigate credit counter anomaly for acct_999 (linked to thread 1766543210). Assigned: charlie (billing), eta: 24h.

charlie (billing): I've pulled the event stream. I see three generator events for resp_abc123 with usage.total_tokens=3 in the API logs, but only two ledger entries: one with debit -3 and one missing. There's a mismatch in the ledger write after retries when idempotency key was present.

ben (support): Root cause hypothesis: SDK 0.9.1 was re-sending without propagating the server-side generation-id, producing duplicate API success responses but only a single ledger write in the database transaction path. We'll confirm.

maria (customer): Ok — will upgrading the SDK 0.9.2 fix this, or do we need a manual credit adjustment?

charlie (billing): Short-term: we'll top up acct_999 by 3 credits to make you whole and open a ledger correction. Long-term: infra will patch the idempotency/ledger commit flow.

ben (support): Action items: 1) charlie will do a +3 credit adjustment now and add a note; 2) infra to deploy ledger fix (REDW-4835) to ensure atomicity for retries; 3) maria please upgrade SDK to 0.9.2 to avoid client-side duplicate behavior.

maria (customer): Thanks — please CC me on the ledger note. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

charlie (billing): Done, ledger note added: "Manual credit +3 for acct_999 due to idempotency retry ledger omission (ref REDW-4829)." ETA infra patch: 48 hours.

ben (support): Closing loop — once infra deploys we'll post a follow-up here and confirm no further anomalies. :thumbsup:

maria (customer): Great, thanks everyone!

infra-bot: REDW-4835 deployed to staging at 2025-11-04T09:10:00Z. Monitoring for 2h.

ben (support): Staging looks good; rolling to prod tonight. I'll update when done.

infra-bot: REDW-4835 deployed to prod at 2025-11-04T23:58:12Z. Monitoring green.

charlie (billing): Verified post-deploy ledger runs — no remaining divergence for acct_999. Manual credit remains recorded.

ben (support): All set. Reopen if you see anything else.
